references.text: Israel declares that the Lord is their God, and the Lord declares that Israel is his people—the same covenant relationship confirmed in 27:9
Israel is a holy people to the Lord, chosen to be his treasured possession—the basis for the declaration of becoming the Lord's people
Moses urges Israel to listen to the laws and statutes—the same command to listen as in 27:9
Shema—Israel's foundational confession to hear and obey the Lord as their God
At Sinai, Israel was established as God's treasured possession and a holy people—the original covenant establishment
The prophet Jeremiah conveys God's promise that he will be their God and they shall be his people
Peter applies the language of God's chosen people to the Christian church—those who were once not a people are now God's people
Christ gave himself to cleanse for God a treasured people—the fulfillment of the covenant relationship
